scope: Pure Node/JSDOM execution of actual production wheel and dropdown listeners, zoom/fit/cancellation functions, pane functions and the actual render-sizing subsection. Plot replacement and viewport geometry are controlled. This is neither actual Chrome input nor a physical zoom/performance claim.
hypothesis: A pending manual zoom frame might leave a new zoom control value paired with the old zoomView after an ordinary tab reuse.
sourceFinding: The sole production queuedZoom assignment is in the modified-wheel listener. That listener does not update the zoom control before its frame.
The manual dropdown onchange synchronously cancels pending wheel work and calls applyPreviewZoom. There is no production manual-dropdown animation-frame queue.
Existing fit callbacks check the current zoomView.fit and queuedZoom before applying. A newer synchronous manual choice takes precedence.

checks: Actual manual dropdown updates zoom synchronously; stable tab reuse preserves zoom, fit, control and exact CSS dimensions.
An existing pending fit frame cannot overwrite a newer actual manual dropdown after a tab switch.
A real production WheelEvent queues work without prewriting the control; reuse and original canonical tab switching settle to the same zoom, fit, control, dimensions and pending state.
An actual manual dropdown supersedes pending wheel work before a tab switch.
An existing fit frame plus pending wheel work settles identically through reuse and original canonical rendering.

retainedInitialPolicyAssertion.assertion: A pending real wheel must take the original canonical fallback
retainedInitialPolicyAssertion.interpretation: This additional routing policy was not an established product requirement. The first three actual-event parity tests had already passed. A routing count difference cannot be reported as a demonstrated zoom desynchronization.
retainedInitialPolicyAssertion.treatment: Original failed tool output is retained. The final tests replace this unsupported policy with real event-order and settled-result assertions; no production guard was added merely to satisfy it.

limit: The tests counter the specific queued-manual-zoom premise and check the listed event orders. They do not establish absence of every possible browser zoom defect.
